questions: What was the most recent small overseas-market/context uncertainty that did not justify a full consulting engagement or hire?
How was it actually solved: customer/friend, internal staff, search, translator/agency, overseas contact or simply judgment under uncertainty?
Did the answer change a real quotation, customer approach, channel choice, product presentation or other decision?
Does the same class recur often enough to matter but too intermittently to justify a dedicated role?
Would an existing translation/localization provider already solve it cheaply enough?
direct_probe_target.promotion_rule: A single anecdote does not promote the formation. Seek repeated same-shaped residual tasks or a concrete current task/decision, then separately validate lawful capability supply and participant commitment.
direct_probe_target.kill_rule: Kill the micro-context missing-edge hypothesis if current staff/customers/search/formal vendors solve these questions cheaply and reliably, or if no such question changes a real business decision.
